He also accused Congress MLC Balmoor Venkat of using his political influence to help encroachers. Venkat has denied the allegation. The Bondi beach incident happened in December 2025 and a father-son duo were charged with mass shooting at the public resulting in 16 deaths. In a video circulating on social media, Rahmat alleged that a group of people had been harassing his family for nearly six years over a 5.5-acre plot owned by his 75-year-old father, Mohammed Azmath Pasha, in Alampally village located near the New Civil Hospital. Rahmat alleged that the group was attempting to lay a road through the property despite a court order protecting his father's possession. Speaking to TNM, Rahmat said that despite police complaints, no action was taken.
